svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: One image serves the API and the React build
svg.desc: One image serves the API and the React build. 7 components in 1 groups. Connections: Browser to FastAPI + Uvicorn; Health checks to FastAPI + Uvicorn (GET /health); FastAPI + Uvicorn to React 19 build; FastAPI + Uvicorn to routes/; routes/ to services/; services/ to MongoDB.

text.tspan: ONE IMAGE SERVES THE API AND THE REACT BUILD
The same container runs under Docker Compose and on ECS; MONGODB_URL picks the database
